correctness.rationale: Read and independently reconstructed the coefficient-extraction Hasse–Witt matrix H and odd/even block decomposition. B rank2 always; C rank<2 would force c=0,ab=1 and singular quintic. The twisted two-step 2×2 block D has det T=a³b³+c³(a⁴−b)−1, and rank-one D on T=0 has second iterate controlled by E=b³+ac³+a^27. Frobenius stable rank doubles, proving 4/2/0. T=(a⁴−b)c³+(ab−1)³ irreducible by noncube pole along a⁴−b. On U∩{T=0}, c≠0 and partial derivatives T_b=−c³,E_a=c³ give smooth transverse codimension-two loci. Three F3 triples witness each stratum. Independent F3 full enumeration and symbolic matrix verification corroborate without replacing generic proof.
residual_risks: Finite F3 exhaustive check does not prove statements over algebraically closed fields.
